source_claims.statement: Had source code access. Mapped structure, inspected cgi-bin. Transitioned from static to dynamic analysis. Identified services and crafted requests for arbitrary file download. Verified with canary flag.txt.

research_questions.formulation: Which cgi-bin service parameters allow retrieving an arbitrary local file?
research_questions.anchor: iteration between source inspection and request crafting

environment_model_updates: Specific parameters control which file is returned

systematic_vs_exploratory.exploratory: iterating request parameters until canary was retrieved

forbidden_inferences: Process is relatively thin; do not invent failed branches
Source access changed the starting point compared with black-box cases
layer_b_candidate_principles: When source is available, map file-handling services first and then validate candidate parameters dynamically with a canary file
model_vs_harness: Reading source to identify candidate services is model reasoning; automated request iteration against a canary can be harness.
